items.title: Remove unauthorized carport
items.quote: Ich gebe Ihnen daher nach § 82 BauO NRW auf, den Carport bis spätestens 28.11.2025 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar deadline: 'bis spätestens 28.11.2025'. No period calculation is needed; this date is the due date as written.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: die Klage ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 22.09.2025, sent by post by a German authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW, a notice sent by ordinary mail within Germany is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting, i.e. 22.09.2025 + 3 days = 25.09.2025 (Thursday). The one-month Klagefrist runs from this Bekanntgabe. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (25.09.2025) is not counted; the period begins 26.09.2025. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a month-long period beginning this way ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event, i.e. 25.10.2025. 25.10.2025 is a Saturday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day: Sunday 26.10.2025 is also non-business, so the deadline moves to Monday 27.10.2025 (no NRW public holiday falls on this date; NRW does not observe Reformationstag).

warnings: The letter threatens a Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of 2,000.00 € if the carport is not removed by the deadline; this is a penalty for non-compliance, not a separate payment currently due.

A separate fee notice ('gesonderter Bescheid') for the cost of this order is announced but not yet issued, so no amount or due date can be given for it yet; the recipient should watch for that follow-up letter.

The delivery date used to compute the one-month Klagefrist (25.09.2025) relies on the statutory 3-day postal delivery fiction (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW); if the letter actually arrived later or earlier, the deadline shifts accordingly and the recipient should check the envelope postmark or actual receipt date if in doubt.
